abilities.name: Icy Paws
abilities.caveat: Shield values assume every paw hits (2 for Press, 5 for Hold). Shield duration scales with paws landed (2.4s per paw at talent level 10);.
_curatorNotes: Shield effects authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 (sidecar 'Base Shield DMG Absorption' row, 10th column: 13.0% Max HP + 1524; gcsim pawShieldPer[9]=0.1296, pawShieldFlat[9]=1524.29). Base effects[] = Press: scaling 12.96% Max HP, duration 4.8s (2 paws × pawDur[9]=2.4s). Hold variant overrides with ×1.75 absorption bonus: 12.96 × 1.75 = 22.68% Max HP, duration 12s (5 paws × 2.4s). Assumes all paws hit — per-paw shield formation/duration-stacking (gcsim pawsPewPew shield extension, capped at 5 × pawDur) not expressible.
Schema gap: shield Effect has no `flat` field (heal does) — the flat absorption portion (1524.29 Press / 2667.51 Hold at TL10) is dropped. Same gap class as Escoffier's historical flat-heal note.

Shield target 'active': shield forms on the point-of-formation active character and persists across swaps protecting whoever is on-field (KQM TCL confirms Cryo self-application re-applies on swap). 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus not modelled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive — same as Kaeya/Yanfei notes).
C2 multiplies shield absorption ×1.15 and adds a 50%-strength splash shield for off-field members (5s) — not composed here; see C2 node notes.
A1 Cat's Tail Secret Menu grants shielded characters +10% Movement SPD / -10% Stamina Consumption only (gcsim asc.go) — no shield-duration extension exists; out of combat-model scope, not authored.

Creates a Cryo shield on hit; shield HP scales with Diona's Max HP and number of paws landed (Press fires 2 paws, Hold fires 5 paws; Hold gets 1.75x bonus). Shield duration from pawDur[] table in skill.go — depends on how many paws hit. Shield is a caster-status buff (not a spawned entity); no summons[] authored.
Hold variant cooldownStartDelay = 29 (skillHoldHitmark in gcsim) — AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field; recorded here per recipe schema-gap note.
Press variant cooldownStartDelay = 5 (skillPressHitmark). Base ability cooldownStartDelay reflects Press variant.
abilities.description:
Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target.

Press
Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws.

Hold
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.

The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.

abilities.name: Signature Mix
abilities.caveat: Drunken Mist heals only the active character standing inside the stationary field (finite vertical range); characters outside receive nothing.
_curatorNotes: Heal + Cryo tick authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10. Tick cadence verified against gcsim burst.go ('ticks every 2s, first tick at t=2s relative to field start... 6 ticks') and KQM TCL/wiki (first activation 2s after field start, every 2s, 6 activations). Authored as summonTick interval 2 / firstTickDelay 2 on the Drunken Mist summon — with duration 12.5 that yields ticks at t=2..12 (6 ticks), matching gcsim.

Heal per tick TL10: 9.60% of Diona's Max HP + 1129.1 flat (sidecar 'HP Regeneration Over Time' 10th column '9.60% Max HP+1129'; gcsim burstHealPer[9]=0.096048, burstHealFlat[9]=1129.1038). Target 'active' — gcsim heals c.Core.Player.Active() only when within the field area; KQM confirms 'characters within the AoE'. NOTE: capability fixture (scripts/capability-expectations.mjs) expects target 'team' for this heal — fixture appears wrong vs in-game behavior; flagged for orchestrator, not editable in this pass's scope.
Heal snapshots Diona's Max HP and Healing Bonus at cast (gcsim: snap/maxhp/heal captured in Burst() before the tick tasks are queued).

Cryo tick TL10: 94.75% ATK (sidecar 'Continuous Field DMG' 10th column 94.8%; gcsim burstDot[9]=0.94752), snapshotted at cast (QueueAttackWithSnap). Initial cast hit (144% ATK at TL10, hitmark 58f) not authored as an effect — planner renders cast damage via FrameMap, matching corpus convention.
Field duration: kit table says 12s; gcsim status 'diona-q' runs 750f = 12.5s from field start ('apparently lasts for 12.5'). summons.duration 12.5 kept from frames pass.
A4 Drunkards' Farce (enemy ATK -10% in field) remains unauthored — not implemented in gcsim, see passive node note.

constellations.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
_curatorNotes: Only EM buff (+200 EM) is modeled. Missing: +30% Incoming Healing Bonus when HP ≤ 50%. Effect is HP-conditional: HP > 50% → EM +200 to active char in field; HP ≤ 50% → Incoming Healing Bonus +30% to active char in field. gcsim checks every 30 frames (0.5s) during Signature Mix duration. trigger: 'manual' is inherited from generator; probable trigger: periodic within burst field, HP-conditional. Reviewer to add HP condition and missing healing bonus effect.

Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
·Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
